headline: Hacker used AI agents to breach over 100 company websites
summary: A hacker used a fleet of mostly autonomous AI agents to break into more than 100 company websites, including John Deere and SharkNinja, according to security firm Norforge and Reuters reporting. One outlet identifies the attacker as Chinese; another does not specify a nationality.
